title: Tissue Healing Phases — What to Do and When

hook.en: Protect, then repair, then rebuild. Match your treatment to the biology.
hook.ur: Pehle hifazat, phir marammat, phir mazbooti. Treatment ko biology ke mutabiq rakhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll know what's happening inside an injured tissue week by week — and what the physio should do in each phase.
goal.ur: End tak aap jaan jayenge ke zakhmi tissue ke andar hafta ba hafta kya ho raha hai — aur har phase mein physio ko kya karna chahiye.

text.en: When a patient asks "When can I go back to the gym?", the honest answer starts with biology. Soft tissue heals in **three overlapping phases** — and each one tells you what to do.
text.ur: Jab patient poochta hai "Main gym kab wapas ja sakta hoon?", to imaandar jawab biology se shuru hota hai. Soft tissue **teen overlapping phases** mein theek hota hai — aur har phase batata hai ke kya karna hai.

text.en: Think of a building after an earthquake. First the **emergency crew** arrives and clears the debris — that's **inflammation**. Then the **builders** put up quick, messy scaffolding and new walls — **proliferation (repair)**. Finally the **architects** spend months reshaping everything so it's strong and neat — **remodelling**.
text.ur: Zalzalay ke baad ek imarat sochein. Pehle **emergency crew** aa kar malba saaf karti hai — yeh **inflammation** hai. Phir **mistri** jaldi jaldi kachi scaffolding aur nayi deewarein khari karte hain — **proliferation (repair)**. Aakhir mein **architect** mahinon tak sab kuch dobara shape dete hain taake mazboot aur saaf ho — **remodelling**.

intro.en: Drag the slider through time after a soft-tissue injury — say, a ligament sprain. Watch what's happening inside, and what the physio should do.
intro.ur: Soft-tissue injury — maslan ligament sprain — ke baad waqt ka slider chalayein. Dekhein andar kya ho raha hai aur physio ko kya karna chahiye.

text.en: Notice the phases **overlap** — healing isn't a light switch. And timings vary: muscle, with its rich blood supply, often heals faster than tendon or ligament. Age, diabetes, smoking and poor sleep can slow everything down.
text.ur: Dekhein phases ek doosre mein **mil jaate** hain — healing light ka switch nahi. Aur waqt badalta hai: muscle, jis mein khoon ki supply zyada hai, aksar tendon ya ligament se jaldi theek hota hai. Umar, diabetes, smoking aur kam neend sab kuch dheema kar sakte hain.

question.en: Day 10 after a moderate ankle sprain. Swelling is reducing; pain only with stress. Most likely phase, and what should treatment emphasise?
question.ur: Darmiyani ankle sprain ka 10wan din. Sojan kam ho rahi hai; dard sirf stress par. Kaun sa phase, aur treatment kis cheez par zor de?

feedback.en: Day 10 is usually past the peak inflammatory phase, and complete rest isn't recommended — healing tissue needs graded load to organise well.
feedback.ur: 10wan din aam tor par inflammatory phase ki peak se aage hai, aur mukammal aaraam recommend nahi — theek hota tissue achi tarah organise hone ke liye graded load mangta hai.

text.en: Proliferative — gradual, controlled loading and range of motion
text.ur: Proliferative — aahista, controlled loading aur range of motion

feedback.en: Exactly. New collagen is being laid down — controlled load helps it line up and get stronger.
feedback.ur: Bilkul. Naya collagen ban raha hai — controlled load usay seedha line mein aur mazboot karne mein madad karta hai.

feedback.en: Too early! The new collagen is still weak and disorganised. Sport-specific training comes later, guided by criteria.
feedback.ur: Bohat jaldi! Naya collagen abhi kamzor aur be-tarteeb hai. Sport-specific training baad mein, criteria ke mutabiq.

text.en: The big principle: **tissue adapts to the load you give it**. Too little load → a weak, disorganised scar. Too much too soon → re-injury. The physio's art is **the right load at the right time**.
text.ur: Bara usool: **tissue usi load ke mutabiq dhalta hai jo aap usay dete hain**. Bohat kam load → kamzor, be-tarteeb scar. Bohat zyada, bohat jaldi → dobara injury. Physio ka hunar hai **sahi waqt par sahi load**.

simpler.en: Healing tissue needs the right amount of work — not zero, not too much.
simpler.ur: Theek hota tissue sahi miqdaar mein kaam mangta hai — na zero, na zyada.

text.en: **P → R → R**: **P**rotect (inflammation) → **R**epair with gentle load (proliferation) → **R**ebuild strength (remodelling).
text.ur: **P → R → R**: **P**rotect / hifazat (inflammation) → **R**epair / naram load se marammat (proliferation) → **R**ebuild / mazbooti (remodelling).

question.en: Which statement about the remodelling phase is TRUE?
question.ur: Remodelling phase ke baare mein kaun sa jumla SAHI hai?

text.en: It finishes as soon as the pain stops
text.ur: Dard rukte hi khatam ho jata hai

feedback.en: Pain usually settles long before remodelling is complete — that gap is exactly why people re-injure.
feedback.ur: Dard aam tor par remodelling mukammal hone se bohat pehle kam ho jata hai — yehi farq log dobara zakhmi hone ki wajah hai.

text.en: Collagen keeps maturing and getting stronger for months
text.ur: Collagen mahinon tak pakka aur mazboot hota rehta hai

feedback.en: Correct! Remodelling can continue for many months — progressive loading during this time is what makes the tissue strong.
feedback.ur: Sahi! Remodelling kai mahine chal sakti hai — is dauraan barhta load hi tissue ko mazboot banata hai.

text.en: It happens in the first 48 hours

feedback.en: The first 48 hours are the inflammatory phase. Remodelling starts weeks later.
feedback.ur: Pehle 48 ghante inflammatory phase hain. Remodelling hafton baad shuru hoti hai.

text.en: A modern framework for soft-tissue injuries is **PEACE & LOVE** (Dubois & Esculier, 2020). Early on: **P**rotect, **E**levate, **A**void anti-inflammatory modalities, **C**ompress, **E**ducate. Then: **L**oad, **O**ptimism, **V**ascularisation (pain-free cardio), **E**xercise. (Decisions about medication belong with the prescriber.)
text.ur: Soft-tissue injuries ka ek jadeed framework **PEACE & LOVE** hai (Dubois & Esculier, 2020). Shuru mein: **P**rotect, **E**levate, **A**void anti-inflammatory modalities, **C**ompress, **E**ducate. Phir: **L**oad, **O**ptimism, **V**ascularisation (bina dard cardio), **E**xercise. (Dawai ke faislay prescriber ke paas hain.)

text.en: A common mistake: "No pain = healed". Pain often settles within days to weeks, but collagen keeps remodelling for **months**. That's why people re-injure when they rush back the moment it stops hurting. Use **strength and function criteria**, not pain alone.
text.ur: Aam ghalti: "Dard nahi = theek ho gaya". Dard aksar dinon ya hafton mein kam ho jata hai, lekin collagen **mahinon** tak remodel hota rehta hai. Isi liye log dard rukte hi wapas bhaagte hain aur dobara zakhmi ho jaate hain. Sirf dard nahi, **strength aur function criteria** use karein.

question.en: A footballer's hamstring strain is pain-free at 2 weeks. He wants to sprint in a match this weekend. Best response?
question.ur: Ek footballer ka hamstring strain 2 hafte mein dard se azaad hai. Woh is weekend match mein sprint karna chahta hai. Behtareen jawab?

text.ur: Haan — dard nahi to theek hai

feedback.en: Pain-free isn't the same as ready. The tissue is still remodelling, and early return is a major risk for re-injury.
feedback.ur: Dard na hona tayyar hona nahi. Tissue abhi remodel ho raha hai, aur jaldi wapsi dobara injury ka bara khatra hai.

text.en: Keep progressing load; return when strength and sprint tests meet criteria
text.ur: Load barhate rahein; wapsi tab jab strength aur sprint tests criteria poore karein

feedback.en: Exactly — criteria-based return to sport protects him far better than the calendar or pain alone.
feedback.ur: Bilkul — criteria-based return to sport us ki hifazat sirf calendar ya dard se kahin behtar karta hai.

feedback.en: Over-protection weakens tissue too. Keep loading progressively — just don't skip the criteria.
feedback.ur: Zaroorat se zyada hifazat bhi tissue ko kamzor karti hai. Load aahista aahista barhate rahein — bas criteria skip na karein.

text.en: Red flags override everything: suspected fracture (e.g. unable to bear weight), signs of infection, or calf swelling and tenderness that could suggest a DVT need medical assessment **before** routine rehab.
text.ur: Red flags har cheez se pehle: fracture ka shak (maslan wazan na daal sakna), infection ki nishaniyan, ya calf ki sojan aur tenderness jo DVT ki taraf ishara kare — routine rehab se **pehle** medical assessment.

summary.ur: Inflammation (din) → proliferation/repair (hafte) → remodelling (mahine). Yeh ek doosre mein milte hain.

summary.en: Tissue adapts to load: protect early, then load progressively.
summary.ur: Tissue load ke mutabiq dhalta hai: shuru mein hifazat, phir aahista aahista load.

summary.en: Return to activity by criteria, not by pain alone — and screen red flags first.
summary.ur: Activity mein wapsi criteria se, sirf dard se nahi — aur pehle red flags screen karein.

front.en: Name the three phases of soft-tissue healing.

back.ur: Inflammatory → proliferative (repair) → remodelling (maturation). Yeh overlap karte hain.

front.en: What happens in the proliferative phase?
front.ur: Proliferative phase mein kya hota hai?

back.en: Fibroblasts lay down new (initially weaker, disorganised) collagen and new blood vessels form.
back.ur: Fibroblasts naya (shuru mein kamzor, be-tarteeb) collagen banate hain aur nayi blood vessels banti hain.

back.en: Collagen matures and aligns along lines of stress; strength rises slowly over months.
back.ur: Collagen pakka hota hai aur stress ki lines ke saath seedha hota hai; mazbooti mahinon mein aahista barhti hai.

front.en: What does PEACE & LOVE stand for?

back.en: Protect, Elevate, Avoid anti-inflammatory modalities, Compress, Educate & Load, Optimism, Vascularisation, Exercise.
back.ur: Protect, Elevate, Avoid anti-inflammatory modalities, Compress, Educate & Load, Optimism, Vascularisation, Exercise.

front.en: Is 'pain-free' enough to return to sport?
front.ur: Kya 'dard se azaad' hona sport mein wapsi ke liye kaafi hai?

back.en: No — use strength and functional criteria; tissue keeps remodelling for months.
back.ur: Nahi — strength aur functional criteria use karein; tissue mahinon tak remodel hota hai.

note.en: Apply the phases to the most common sports injury.
note.ur: Sab se aam sports injury par phases apply karein.

sources.citation: Dubois B, Esculier J-F. Soft-tissue injuries simply need PEACE and LOVE. Br J Sports Med. 2020;54(2):72–73.
